item.title: UNO, OC withdrawn after Sherpur political clash: EC
item.description: The authorities have withdrawn Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) and officer-in-charge (OC) of Jhenaigati Police Station following a deadly clash between activists of BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami in Sherpur’s Jhenaigati upazila.Election Commission (EC) Secretary Akhtar Ahmed confirmed the decision on Thursday.The clash took place on Wednesday noon at Mini Stadium in Jhenaigati during an all-party, election-related programme.The violence reportedly erupted over a dispute regarding who would occupy the fro

item.title: Govt to split CAAB into regulatory, operational bodies
item.description: The government has decided in principle to split Civil Aviation Authority of Bangladesh (CAAB) into separate regulatory and operational entities in a bid to eliminate conflicts of interest and enhance aviation safety, security and service standards.CAAB was informed of the decision through an official letter issued by Ministry of Civil Aviation and Tourism on Wednesday, according to a press release issued by the ministry on Thursday.The ministry said CAAB has long been performing dual roles; ove

item.title: Court sets Feb 3 for CID probe report in Shaheed Hadi murder case

item.title: 55,341 postal ballots reach country
item.description: A total of 445,588 expatriate voters who registered through Postal Vote BD mobile app have already cast their votes in the 13th national elections and referendum, officials said on Thursday.Of these, 55,341 completed postal ballots have so far reached Bangladesh, according to Election Commission (EC).Salim Ahmad Khan, team leader of Out of Country Voting (OCV) System Development and Implementation (SDI) Project, said postal ballots were sent to 244,625 registered expatriate voters across 52 dist

item.title: Tax return submission deadline extended to Feb 28

item.title: HC clears way for deal with foreign operator for New Mooring terminal
item.description: The High Court on Thursday dismissed a rule issued on a writ petition challenging the legality of Chittagong Port Authority’s (CPA) process of signing an agreement with a foreign company to operate the New Mooring Container Terminal (NCT) at Chittagong Port.Justice Zafar Ahmed passed the order after hearing arguments from all sides, effectively removing any legal barrier to the CPA proceeding with the agreement to hand over NCT operations to a foreign operator.Additional Attorney General Anik R.

item.title: Govt approves several ordinances, proposals

item.title: Mirza Fakhrul urges training, jobs for women and youth
item.description: BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir on Tuesday urged the creation of employment opportunities through education and training for women and youth, saying sustainable development depends on people earning through their own work.He made the remarks while addressing an election path rally at Ward No. 8 of Salandar union under Thakurgaon Sadar upazila.Calling on voters to support the BNP in the upcoming national election, Mirza Fakhrul urged them to vote for the party’s electoral symbol
